name: Winnovation Culturaltainment Development Limited
summary: Winnovation Culturaltainment Development Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development activities in China and internationally. It operates through Real Estate, Cultural and Tourism, and Other segments. The company is involved in the development and operation of cultural and tourism scenic spots covering museums, cultural performances, entertainment experiences, homestays, hotels, guest houses, and cultural tourism design institutes; hotel management; travel agency; construction; property services; tourism services; planning and design; schools; and other businesses.
